label: Raindrop Collection
description: A Raindrop collection — a folder that groups raindrops (bookmarks). Collections nest via `parent_id` chains. Source-of-truth for collection metadata; raindrops link back via `collection_id` and a `parent-of` edge.

parent_id.description: External Raindrop id of the parent collection (when this collection is nested). Empty / unset at top level.

count.description: Number of raindrops in this collection at last sync.

cover.description: Cover image URL (Raindrop ships one when set).

expanded.description: Whether the collection is expanded in Raindrop's UI.

color.description: Operator-assigned color (Raindrop ships free-form CSS strings).

public.description: Whether the collection has a public URL.
